thread:
olivia_onboarding: Heads up — AstraNova asked for a 3-part enablement sprint next week to prep their infra + app engineers for a private deployment. They want exec presence for the renewal conversation, hands-on walkthroughs for our Dedicated onboarding, and a brief handoff checklist. Can we lock a 4hr window split into 3 blocks?

maya_cs: +1. Suggest we make it asynchronous-friendly — two blocks live, one recorded deep-dive. Timezone: PST-friendly preferred (customer EMEA team joining later via recording).

sam_se: @olivia_onboarding I can run the dedicated infra walkthrough (45m). Avail Tue/Wed 10:30-14:30 PT. Need a sample config from them beforehand and access to their staging tokens.

felix_cs: I'll own the renewal exec intro (15m) and the final Q&A (30m). We should invite their CSM + their ops lead. Also recommend a short pre-survey to capture current blockers.

olivia_onboarding: Great. Proposed structure (compact):
```
1) Exec intro + renewal signals (15m) - tara_manager + felix_cs
2) Hands-on Dedicated onboarding (75m) - sam_se
3) Break + async lab (30m)
4) App-integration patterns + sample prompts (45m) - maya_cs
5) Live Q&A + next steps & handoff checklist (25m)
```
We want clear owner for: calendar invite, pre-survey, pre-req checklist, recording + artifacts.

tara_manager: I can join the exec intro and will handle the renewal ask. Can someone create a short one-question pre-survey we can send 48h before? (risk scale: 1-5 and one free text)

maya_cs: I'll draft the pre-survey and the integration patterns doc. Link to initial draft: https://docs.redwood.example/astranova-integration-draft (please comment).

sam_se: For pre-reqs we need: staging API key, a small sample dataset, and network allowlist for our IPs. I'll DM the exact CIDR range.

felix_cs: Poll for live slot: Tue 11:00-15:00 PT or Wed 10:00-14:00 PT. Reply with ✅ for Tue or ✅ for Wed (or both).

maya_cs: ✅ Tue for me.

olivia_onboarding: ✅ Tue.

sam_se: ✅ Wed only (need Wed due to deployment window).

tara_manager: ✅ Tue preferred, Wed backup.

calendar-bot: Created tentative event "AstraNova Enablement Sprint - preflight + handoff" on Tue 2025-06-17 11:30 PT — invite pending confirmations. Link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=astranova-evt-2025

olivia_onboarding: Thanks — action items: 1) @maya_cs produce pre-survey + send 48h before, 2) @sam_se share CIDR + pre-req list to the customer and CS, 3) @felix_cs assemble exec deck (5 slides), 4) tara_manager present renewal ask. I'll finalize invite once Sam/Ecs confirm network timing. Please add any blockers here.

maya_cs: I'll post pre-survey draft by EOD and collect comments. Also will prepare a 10-min screencast for the async lab. :white_check_mark:

sam_se: DMing CIDR now. If customer can't provide staging key by 24h prior we convert hands-on to a live demo with our sandbox.

felix_cs: Adding the exec deck to the event and tagging renewal metrics.

olivia_onboarding: Perfect. If any change, update thread. We'll capture feedback via the pre-survey + post-session NPS.
